reasons: Directionally correct: Singapore law/exclusive Singapore courts is outside the accepted set and near the walk-away position, so a deviation finding is warranted.

The redline lands exactly on the preferred position (New York law, exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts in New York County) while preserving the sentence structure; the changed-character ratio is expected for a governing-law substitution.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, states the playbook position and offers the Delaware/California/England-and-Wales fallback.
